sanskrit:
कच्चिन्नोभयविभ्रष्टश्छिन्नाभ्रमिव नश्यति ।
अप्रतिष्ठो महाबाहो विमूढो ब्रह्मणः पथि ॥ ६-३८॥
iast:
kaccinnobhayavibhraṣṭaś chinnābhramiva naśyati
apratiṣṭho mahābāho vimūḍho brahmaṇaḥ pathi 6-38
translation: Fallen from both, does he not, O mighty-armed, perish like a rent cloud, supportless and deluded in the path of BRAHMAN?
